# Forza Horizon 6 Guide

> An unofficial, community-driven strategy guide for Forza Horizon 6 (Horizon Japan): cars, barn finds, treasure cars, aftermarket & Forza Edition cars, houses, the interactive Japan map, and a beginner's path to Horizon Legend. Primary source: the English Wikipedia article; community guides fill gameplay detail and are labelled as such.

## Guide sections
- [Full guide (llms-full.txt)](https://www.forza-horizon-6.com/llms-full.txt): the complete guide as clean, citable markdown — beginner path, car list, best cars, map regions, barn finds, treasure cars, aftermarket/Forza Edition cars, houses, critic scores, and development timeline.
- [Live site](https://www.forza-horizon-6.com/): the interactive guide. Every section below has its own real URL with the content server-rendered, so it is readable without executing JavaScript.

## Pages (real URLs, content inlined in the HTML)
- [Cars](https://www.forza-horizon-6.com/cars/): roster, best picks by discipline, aftermarket & Forza Edition cars, and the Barn Find / Treasure Car lists.
- [Barn Finds](https://www.forza-horizon-6.com/barn-finds/): all 15, with car, unlock stamp tier, region and landmark pointer.
- [Treasure Cars](https://www.forza-horizon-6.com/treasure-cars/): all 9, with region and where to look.
- [Interactive Map](https://www.forza-horizon-6.com/map/): regions of Japan and what is scattered across them.
- [Beginner's Guide](https://www.forza-horizon-6.com/beginner/): 14-step path to Horizon Legend.
- [Houses & Property](https://www.forza-horizon-6.com/houses/): The Estate, the 8 Garages and the buyable houses.
- [Guides & Wiki](https://www.forza-horizon-6.com/guides/): walkthroughs and the systems encyclopedia.
- [Festival Playlist](https://www.forza-horizon-6.com/playlist/): seasons, event types and progress tracking.
- [FAQ](https://www.forza-horizon-6.com/faq/): release, platforms, PS5 status, Game Pass, PC specs, cars, houses, progression.
